info.title: Willowsum API
info.description: The one HTTP API of every Willowsum client (ARC-07). Within /v1 only compatible changes are made; removal only after a deprecation mark and at least 6 months. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a machine code.

post.summary: A user action in this browser: extend the session and rotate its token

x-willowsum-access.public: Sign-up, email confirmation, sign-in and password reset work before a session or a space exists (ACC-01)

200.description: The client sends it for user actions only (click, input, navigation; ACC-04 business rules), never for background requests. The 15 min idle deadline moves for every tab of the browser and the session cookie gets a new token (NFR-01 FR 12); the 12 h end never moves. A token replaced less than 30 s ago (another tab's request on its way) extends the session without a new token; one replaced earlier ends the session (401 SESSION_ENDED, ended-elsewhere)

currentVersion.description: VERSION_CONFLICT: the current version of the record

changedFields.description: VERSION_CONFLICT: the fields changed since the client's version — the readable fields of the base values it sent whose stored value now differs (field names only; fields left out of the base are not reported)

sessionEndReason.description: SESSION_ENDED: idle (15 min without a user action), expired (12 h after sign-in), signed-out (this browser signed out), ended-elsewhere (a password reset, a password change in the profile on another device, «Це був не я» or a reused token ended it)

limit.description: LIMIT_REACHED: the limit that was reached

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details with a machine-readable code (ARC-07 FR 4).
